request: Activate the complete Kalaxy3 SAGE mandatory operating contract. Require current Git, GitHub, SAGE, and runtime authority before mutation; evidence-based selection and reuse of repository-owned components; composition manifests; capability-gap receipts; real runtime validation; failure diagnosis that records what failed, what should have been done, which existing component should have been used, why the actual path differed, and the reusable correction; measurable outcome, reuse, authority, failure, rework, and safety statistics; Git credential and history safety; and an operator-executed, visible, one-boundary-at-a-time Git/GitHub mutation gate. Downloaded implementation helpers may edit and validate repository files but may only inspect Git read-only and may not create or switch branches, stage, commit, push, pull, merge, rebase, reset, clean, delete refs, mutate GitHub, or deploy.
required_capability: Production helper rejection of Git, GitHub, credential, and deployment mutation paths.

candidates_considered.insufficiency: The current guardrail covers tracked compositions but not arbitrary downloaded implementation helpers or GH_CONFIG_DIR and token inheritance.

gap.missing_interface_or_behavior: A reusable source scanner with protected command, API, credential, and fixture-boundary rules.
gap.why_configuration_is_insufficient: Adding names to the composition policy does not scan external helper files or distinguish isolated fixtures.
gap.why_composition_is_insufficient: Composing existing discovery and validation primitives cannot prove a helper source lacks prohibited mutation paths.

proposed_primitive.responsibility: Statically reject protected-system mutation and credential inheritance in delivered helpers while allowing isolated temporary-repository fixtures.
proposed_primitive.idempotency: Deterministic for unchanged source and fixture root.
proposed_primitive.logging: Violation path, line, code, and redacted description.
proposed_primitive.failure_mode: Any prohibited path fails closed before helper delivery or execution.

approval.rationale: The operator explicitly approved the Phase 2 least-authority safety-foundation gaps.
